reviews.title: Great buy
reviews.comment: This thang is thangin’!!!! The combo of 7800X3D and this B850 TUF gaming mobo should make your system “future proof “ for a while. And with these memory price hikes getting on AM5+ or any running DDR5 may be a vastly expensive ( if not potentially impossible) task- thanks AI! The build quality is great as the b850 tuf gaming branded is ASUS’ mid to high tier line of products so you can expect little things like extra aRBG and Fan headers on your board for cool lighting you can always turn off the lighting too if that’s not your thing.  You will also have decent warranty and ongoing support for your board. The board comes with a flashback usb slot to get your board up to date to get the expo profiles and fixes for the cpu before you ever seat the chip The Ryzen 7 7800x3d rips through all my tasks and games. I use mudbox, maya, revit for some SFX, premiere & after effects for editing, and rotoscoping, this thing powers through them all. Gaming wise there’s nothing I cant run at max settings 1440p with my 5080. CPU handles all the data just fine no bottle backing. I will over clock once I get a better cooler - Cyberpunk 2077 max settings DLSS with Framegen gets me 300fps on avg and 55C temps on the block. This thing hums. Overall I’m glad I purchased

reviews.title: Major Upgrade
reviews.comment: Bought it for my sister so she could upgrade from Ryzen 5 3600 and she couldn't be happier. I wish I lived close to a Micro Center but this is as good as it's gonna get. She went from the 3600 and 3060 12gb to this and a 5070ti. With prices continually increasing for ram, cpus and everything else. I'm happy she was able to upgrade now instead of waiting even though it hurt the wallet it was worth it.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Amazing bang for buck, this processor restored my faith in humanity.
reviews.comment: This will be the best combo you could ask for, I am not really a motherboard enthusiast but plenty of PCIE 5.0 NVME slots, and this processor has been the biggest upgrade I have seen in performance in a long time; I paired mine with a 5070 and couldn't ask for a better setup for 1440p gaming. Notes: NO BLUETOOTH, only Wi-Fi connection ability (so that means you cannot use your Xbox controller wirelessly) It has 2, 4 pin connectors on the motherboard, you only need to use the right slot and I'm not sure what the secondary slot could be for other than increased power demands beyond comprehension.
